task.title: Installing Podman
task.shortdesc: To install Podman on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) for a proof of concept Red Hat Quay deployment, you can use yum to install the podman package or the container-tools module. Podman is required for running registry containers in this guide.

context.p: This document uses Podman for creating and deploying containers.

note.p: If you do not have Podman installed on your system, the use of equivalent Docker commands might be possible, however this is not recommended. Docker is not tested with Red Hat Quay 3.18, and will be deprecated in a future release. Podman is recommended for highly available, production quality deployments of Red Hat Quay 3.18.
